description: Friday 21:20: Keisha Robinson emails Reggie, in a new thread, her phone photo of the counseling office's tally of spring CTE elective requests as Angela Brooks updated it again: two blue marks added after Metalworking & Welding I's twenty-three, 'late adds 12/11 - AB', for 25 (Advanced Fabrication's late adds of 12/9 still on it). The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it.

filesystem.description: The attachment of Keisha Robinson (who photographed the counseling office's tally again)'s mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. the counseling office's tally after two late Metalworking & Welding I sign-ups: 25.
